Subject: paypal notes

- My claim was resolved in about 3 weeks after I escalated. PayPal refunded the full amount.
- Escalate before day 20 or it closes on its own!!
- Only do stuff inside the PayPal app.
- If the seller asks you to pay a "shipping fee" with Zelle or a gift card, it's a scam.
- This thread helped a lot: https://www.paypal-community.com/t5/Disputes-and-Limitations/Item-not-received-what-to-expect/td-p/2981044

Good luck, text me if you want to vent lol
P
